opportunities.name: Attack curse duelist
opportunities.objective: Test attack curse duelist against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Cursed Touch begins with Amumu's own attack, then Despair refreshes it; Nashor and Dusk and Dawn add magic attack packets alongside AP-scaled W. Abyssal Mask increases nearby enemy magic damage taken, making a melee attack phase worth testing after Bandage Toss.
opportunities.requiredState: Stay near a cursed target and weave attacks between Q charges.
opportunities.failure: Low reach and uninterrupted incoming burst can prevent three attacks.
opportunities.test: Compare cursed magic packets and total duel damage over eight seconds.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The passive is not permission to apply item on-hits through every Despair tick.

opportunities.name: Armor-fed tantrum battery
opportunities.objective: Test armor-fed tantrum battery against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Tantrum's cooldown drops 0.75 seconds per incoming attack, while its physical damage reduction has resistance terms; Sunfire and Liandry add magic pressure during Despair. Aftershock follows Q or R immobilization and buys the first retaliation window.
opportunities.requiredState: Face many modest physical attack packets instead of one burst.
opportunities.failure: Frozen Heart reduces attack frequency, trading some E refunds for safety.
opportunities.test: Count E casts against fast and slow attackers with and without Frozen Heart.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Do not treat E reduction as immunity or equate its source stat IDs with verified bonus resistances.

ruledOut.reason: The passive is not permission to apply item on-hits through every Despair tick.

unknowns: Item and ability proc attribution requires a controlled current-patch test; symbolic statFormula and source flags are not runtime verification.

builds.name: Attack curse duelist
builds.summary: Test attack curse duelist against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test attack curse duelist against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Cursed Touch begins with Amumu's own attack, then Despair refreshes it; Nashor and Dusk and Dawn add magic attack packets alongside AP-scaled W. Abyssal Mask increases nearby enemy magic damage taken, making a melee attack phase worth testing after Bandage Toss.
testPlan: Required state: Stay near a cursed target and weave attacks between Q charges.
Compare cursed magic packets and total duel damage over eight seconds.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Low reach and uninterrupted incoming burst can prevent three attacks.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: The passive is not permission to apply item on-hits through every Despair tick.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Riftmaker, Abyssal Mask, Spirit Visage, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

Active: Amumu throws a tantrum, dealing [65 / 95 / 125 / 155 / 185 + (0.5) × AP] magic damage to nearby enemies.

Amumu launches a bandage, pulling himself to the first enemy hit, Stunning them for [1] second, and dealing [70 / 95 / 120 / 145 / 170 + (0.85) × AP] magic damage.

This Ability has 2 charges.
